events.title: The Black Prince captures King John II at Poitiers
events.description: Edward the Black Prince's outnumbered army defeated the French at Poitiers and captured King John II. His huge ransom and the chaos that followed brought France to the brink of collapse.
events.html: Edward the Black Prince's outnumbered army defeated the French at Poitiers and captured King John II. His huge ransom and the chaos that followed brought France to the brink of collapse.

events.title: Nathaniel Bacon's rebels burn Jamestown
events.description: Rebels led by Nathaniel Bacon burned Virginia's capital, Jamestown, in a revolt against Governor Berkeley. Their alliance of poor whites, servants and enslaved Africans alarmed the colony's elite.
events.html: Rebels led by Nathaniel Bacon burned Virginia's capital, Jamestown, in a revolt against Governor Berkeley. Their alliance of poor whites, servants and enslaved Africans alarmed the colony's elite.

events.title: George Washington's Farewell Address is published
events.description: Washington announced he would not seek a third term in an address printed in a Philadelphia newspaper. He warned against party faction and permanent foreign alliances.
events.html: Washington announced he would not seek a third term in an address printed in a Philadelphia newspaper. He warned against party faction and permanent foreign alliances.

events.title: President James Garfield dies 79 days after being shot
events.description: Garfield died of infection and complications from the wound inflicted by Charles Guiteau. His doctors' unsterile probing of the wound almost certainly contributed to his death.
events.html: Garfield died of infection and complications from the wound inflicted by Charles Guiteau. His doctors' unsterile probing of the wound almost certainly contributed to his death.

events.title: Hikers find Ötzi the Iceman in the Alps
events.description: Two German hikers found a body in the ice on the Austrian-Italian border. Ötzi proved to be a man who died some 5,300 years ago, killed by an arrow, with his clothes and tools preserved.
events.html: Two German hikers found a body in the ice on the Austrian-Italian border. Ötzi proved to be a man who died some 5,300 years ago, killed by an arrow, with his clothes and tools preserved.
